column1: # family-entries.tsv (harbor#1245) — a file of a family that module.private-use would take for private, declared its public entry.
# WHY THIS FILE EXISTS. standards/modularity.md M3 reads a `-lib` file as private to its family, and bin/deploy-install-lib.sh is the
# one the install path of four other families (drift, lint, skill) calls by design: four subjects of module.private-use for a file
# that is the deploy family's interface in fact. The operator decided on 2026-11-03 that it is the entry, so the file says so
# rather than the rule being loosened for every `-lib` file.
#   system   the graph input the path belongs to (harbor)
#   path     repo-relative file; it is public to every family, and module.private-use stops judging it
#   reason   why this file, not a copy of it, is the family's interface

column3: the deploy family's entry (operator decision 2026-11-03, harbor#1245): drift, lint and skill call its install functions on purpose
